readingText.content:
Two amazing animals

Humans can shake their arms, jump and dance. Some people can even move their ears! We can move our bodies in lots of different ways. But animals can do some amazing things that humans can’t! Here are two examples:

Basilisk lizards

Can you run on water? The animal in the photo can! It’s called the basilisk lizard. The lizard’s short back legs help it run fast. On water, basilisk lizards can run for about 5 metres! How heavy are basilisk lizards? Females can be about 300 grams and males can be 600 grams.

Owls

Look at the bird in the photo. It’s an owl. Can you turn your head like this? Owls can turn their heads almost all the way round! This helps them see things to their right and left. Owls can be very small or very big. Some are about 13 centimetres tall. Others can be about 80 centimetres – that’s almost a metre!
